# Maison Kriss — Extended Plain-Text Reference

> Note: This /llms-full.txt file is an AI-agent discovery aid only. It is NOT a Google Search ranking signal and is not displayed in the storefront UI.

## Brand Identity

- **Name:** Maison Kriss
- **Canonical Domain:** https://www.maisonkriss.shop
- **Category:** Independent Nigerian contemporary clothing and object studio
- **Origin:** Lagos, Nigeria
- **Model:** Members-only private archive and numbered garment releases

## Editorial Philosophy (from /story)

Maison Kriss is an independent Nigerian contemporary clothing and object studio born out of Lagos. Every garment is engineered as an everyday uniform: heavyweight natural fabrics, sharp architectural proportions, and functional hardware built to outlast trend cycles.

Garments are crafted in small numbered runs in Lagos, Nigeria. Flagship silhouettes focus on structured heavyweight fleece, dense heavyweight jersey with high-density plastisol graphics, and rigid washed heavyweight denim designed for durability and everyday rotation.

## Client Services & Fulfillment (from /contact)

Every Maison Kriss release is produced in numbered batches and fulfilled directly from the Lagos studio.

### Studio Hours (Africa/Lagos — WAT)
- **Monday – Friday:** 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM WAT
- **Saturday:** 11:00 AM – 4:00 PM WAT
- **Sunday:** Closed (WhatsApp messages answered Monday morning)

### Dispatch, Delivery & Exchanges
- **Lagos Metro:** Same-day or next business day courier dispatch after payment confirmation.
- **Nationwide Nigeria:** 2–4 business days via tracked express courier.
- **Returns & Exchanges:** Unworn garments with original tags may be exchanged within 7 days of delivery.

### Verified Support Channels
- **Contact Page:** https://www.maisonkriss.shop/contact
- **Email:** support@maisonkriss.shop
- **Order Reference Format:** MK-YYYY-XXXX (include when contacting support about sizing, dispatch, or payment assistance)
